## SKY029 https://docs.skylit.ai/api-reference/heatmap/live-per-strike-heatmap-one-or-more-symbols
openapi: "3.1.0"
info: {"title":"Skylit Public API","version":"1.0.0","summary":"Options-Greeks heatmaps as a public HTTP API.","description":"Skylit exposes its real-time options-Greeks (gamma / vanna) heatmaps as a\nversioned public HTTP API, per strike, with the live velocity metric and\nSkylit's node classification (King / Gatekeeper / etc.).\n\n**Authentication.** Send your Skylit API key as a bearer token:\n\n    Authorization: Bearer <key>\n\n(`X-API-Key: <key>` is also accepted.)\n\n**Credit metering.** Every chargeable request debits a fixed cost from\nyour credit balance:\n\n| Endpoint        | Cost |\n|-----------------|-----:|\n| `/v1/heatmap`    | 1   |\n| `/v1/historical` | 5   |\n| `/v1/stream`     | 1 per minute open |\n| `/v1/openapi.json` | 0 |\n\nNew customers are seeded with 5,000 credits. Every chargeable response\ncarries `X-Credits-Remaining: <balance>`. Out of credits → `402`\n`insufficient_credits`; an admin-suspended account → `403`\n`account_suspended`. Top up via your account console.\n\n**Rate limits.** A safety ceiling of 600 requests / minute is enforced\nby the Skylit gateway and surfaced via `X-RateLimit-Limit`,\n`X-RateLimit-Remaining`, and `X-RateLimit-Reset`. `429` includes\n`Retry-After`. This is a runaway-protection ceiling, not a quota —\ncredit metering does the per-customer accounting.\n\nSee [the credits doc](https://github.com/SkylitAI/skylit-main/blob/main/docs/api-credits.md)\nfor the full lifecycle, including live-stream pricing.\n\n**Resolution.** The heatmap is a 1-second time series. Endpoints return the\nsingle snapshot nearest the requested instant — poll `/v1/heatmap` every\n60-90s for live, or query `/v1/historical` at any minute boundary for a\n1-minute replay grid (no server-side downsampling needed).\n\n**Velocity is live-only.** The `velocityPct` field is present on\n`/v1/heatmap` (live) and absent on `/v1/historical` (replay).\n\n**Response shape.** Success → `{ \"data\": ..., \"meta\": { ... } }`; errors →\n`{ \"error\": { \"code\": \"...\", \"message\": \"...\" } }`. camelCase throughout.\n`data.symbols` is always an array (one element per requested symbol), so a\nsingle-symbol call and a multi-symbol \"Trinity\" call share one shape.\n"}
servers: [{"url":"https://api.skylit.ai","description":"Production"}]
security: [{"bearerApiKey":[]}]
tags: [{"name":"Heatmap"},{"name":"Meta"}]
paths: {"/v1/heatmap":{"get":{"tags":["Heatmap"],"summary":"Live per-strike heatmap (one or more symbols)","description":"Current per-strike heatmap for one or more symbols at the latest\nsnapshot. Includes the live `velocityPct` per strike. Pass multiple\ncomma-separated symbols for a single cross-asset (Trinity) call.\n","operationId":"getHeatmap","parameters":[{"$ref":"#/components/parameters/Symbols"},{"$ref":"#/components/parameters/Metric"},{"$ref":"#/components/parameters/MaxStrikes"}],"responses":{"200":{"description":"Live heatmap snapshot(s).","headers":{"Cache-Control":{"schema":{"type":"string","example":"private, max-age=5"}},"X-RateLimit-Limit":{"schema":{"type":"integer"}},"X-RateLimit-Remaining":{"schema":{"type":"integer"}},"X-RateLimit-Reset":{"schema":{"type":"integer"}}},"content":{"application/json":{"schema":{"type":"object","required":["data","meta"],"properties":{"data":{"type":"object","required":["symbols"],"properties":{"symbols":{"type":"array","items":{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/SymbolHeatmap"}}}},"meta":{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/Meta"}}},"examples":{"live":{"summary":"SPY live (truncated)","value":{"data":{"symbols":[{"symbol":"SPY","asOf":"2026-05-22T14:31:00Z","spot":591.23,"previousClose":589.1,"priceChange":2.13,"priceChangePercent":0.36,"expirations":["2026-05-22","2026-05-23","2026-05-30"],"strikes":[{"strike":590,"value":1894300.4,"nodeType":"king","velocityPct":12.4},{"strike":595,"value":642100.2,"nodeType":"gatekeeper","velocityPct":-3.1},{"strike":585,"value":88010,"nodeType":"normal","velocityPct":0.4}]}]},"meta":{"metric":"gamma","resolution":"1m","mode":"live","cached":false}}}}}}},"400":{"$ref":"#/components/responses/BadRequest"},"401":{"$ref":"#/components/responses/Unauthorized"},"403":{"$ref":"#/components/responses/Forbidden"},"404":{"$ref":"#/components/responses/NotFound"},"429":{"$ref":"#/components/responses/RateLimited"},"503":{"$ref":"#/components/responses/Unavailable"}}}}}
component parameters/Symbols: {"name":"symbols","in":"query","required":true,"description":"One ticker, or a comma-separated list for a single cross-asset call\n(e.g. `SPY` or `SPY,SPX,QQQ`). Each is returned as an element of\n`data.symbols`.\n","schema":{"type":"string","example":"SPY,SPX,QQQ"}}
component parameters/Metric: {"name":"metric","in":"query","required":false,"description":"Which Greek exposure to return per strike.","schema":{"type":"string","enum":["gamma","vanna"],"default":"gamma"}}
component parameters/MaxStrikes: {"name":"maxStrikes","in":"query","required":false,"description":"Maximum number of strikes around spot to return.","schema":{"type":"integer","default":92,"minimum":1,"maximum":400}}
component schemas/SymbolHeatmap: {"type":"object","required":["symbol","asOf","spot","previousClose","priceChange","priceChangePercent","expirations","strikes"],"properties":{"symbol":{"type":"string","description":"Canonical ticker for the returned data."},"asOf":{"type":"string","format":"date-time","description":"RFC3339 timestamp of the snapshot actually returned (nearest to the requested instant)."},"spot":{"type":"number","description":"Spot price at the snapshot."},"previousClose":{"type":"number"},"priceChange":{"type":"number","description":"Spot minus previous close."},"priceChangePercent":{"type":"number"},"expirations":{"type":"array","description":"Expiration dates (YYYY-MM-DD) contributing to each strike's net value.","items":{"type":"string","format":"date"}},"strikes":{"type":"array","description":"Per-strike nodes, ordered by strike ascending.","items":{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/StrikeNode"}}}}
component schemas/Meta: {"type":"object","required":["metric","resolution","mode","cached"],"properties":{"metric":{"type":"string","enum":["gamma","vanna"]},"resolution":{"type":"string","example":"1m"},"mode":{"type":"string","enum":["live","historical"]},"cached":{"type":"boolean","description":"True if served from the in-process cache."}}}
component schemas/StrikeNode: {"type":"object","required":["strike","value","nodeType"],"properties":{"strike":{"type":"number","description":"Strike price."},"value":{"type":"number","description":"Net exposure for the selected `metric` at this strike (summed across the returned expirations)."},"nodeType":{"type":"string","description":"Skylit's node classification for this strike.","enum":["king","gatekeeper","pika","barney","significant","normal"]},"velocityPct":{"type":"number","description":"Live percent change of this strike's value over the velocity window.\nPresent on `/v1/heatmap` only; omitted on `/v1/historical`.\n"}}}

component responses/Forbidden: {"description":"Key revoked or expired, or monthly quota exceeded.","content":{"application/json":{"schema":{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/Error"}}}}

component responses/RateLimited: {"description":"Per-minute rate limit exceeded.","headers":{"Retry-After":{"schema":{"type":"integer"}}},"content":{"application/json":{"schema":{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/Error"}}}}
component responses/Unavailable: {"description":"Heatmap data is temporarily unavailable.","content":{"application/json":{"schema":{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/Error"}}}}

Up to 365 days back.","schema":{"type":"string","format":"date-time"}},{"$ref":"#/components/parameters/Metric"},{"$ref":"#/components/parameters/MaxStrikes"}],"responses":{"200":{"description":"Historical heatmap snapshot(s).","headers":{"X-RateLimit-Limit":{"schema":{"type":"integer"}},"X-RateLimit-Remaining":{"schema":{"type":"integer"}},"X-RateLimit-Reset":{"schema":{"type":"integer"}}},"content":{"application/json":{"schema":{"type":"object","required":["data","meta"],"properties":{"data":{"type":"object","required":["symbols"],"properties":{"symbols":{"type":"array","items":{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/SymbolHeatmap"}}}},"meta":{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/Meta"}}},"examples":{"replay":{"summary":"SPY at a past minute (truncated)","value":{"data":{"symbols":[{"symbol":"SPY","asOf":"2026-03-05T10:01:00Z","spot":512.4,"previousClose":510.02,"priceChange":2.38,"priceChangePercent":0.47,"expirations":["2026-03-05","2026-03-06"],"strikes":[{"strike":512,"value":1500200,"nodeType":"king"},{"strike":515,"value":410000,"nodeType":"gatekeeper"}]}]},"meta":{"metric":"gamma","resolution":"1m","mode":"historical","cached":false}}}}}}},"400":{"$ref":"#/components/responses/BadRequest"},"401":{"$ref":"#/components/responses/Unauthorized"},"403":{"$ref":"#/components/responses/Forbidden"},"404":{"description":"No snapshot at/near the requested instant (or unknown symbol).","content":{"application/json":{"schema":{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/Error"},"examples":{"noData":{"value":{"error":{"code":"no_data","message":"No snapshot available for SPY at 2025-01-01T10:01:00Z."}}}}}}},"429":{"$ref":"#/components/responses/RateLimited"},"503":{"$ref":"#/components/responses/Unavailable"}}}}}

paths: {"/v1/stream":{"get":{"tags":["Heatmap"],"summary":"Live SSE stream (one symbol per connection)","description":"A **Server-Sent Events** (`text/event-stream`) feed of live per-strike\nheatmap updates for **one** symbol. Open one connection per symbol.\n\n**Events:**\n- `connected` — handshake, payload `{symbol, creditsRemaining}`.\n- `initial_data` — current heatmap snapshot on connect.\n- `snapshot_update` — full heatmap on each change.\n- `velocity_update` — per-strike % change.\n- `credits` — emitted every minute boundary, payload `{remaining}`.\n- `closed` — stream terminates with `{reason: \"insufficient_credits\"\n  | \"account_suspended\" | \"credit_check_failed\"}`.\n- `reconnect` — server is recycling the connection (after ~1h),\n  payload `{reason: \"max_duration\"}`. Reconnect to continue.\n- `: keepalive` comment every 30s for proxy keepalive.\n\n**Pricing.** 1 credit on connect (charged before the SSE upgrade —\nan under-funded client gets a clean `402` HTTP response, not a\nhalf-open stream), then 1 credit per minute open. The per-minute\nticker emits `event: credits {remaining: N}` after each successful\ndebit so clients can budget the next minute.\n\n**Concurrency.** Up to 5 concurrent streams per customer per pod.\nExceeding the cap returns `429` `stream_limit_reached`.\n\n> OpenAPI is request/response-oriented and can't fully model an event\n> stream. See [docs/api-credits.md](https://github.com/SkylitAI/skylit-main/blob/main/docs/api-credits.md#live-stream-v1stream)\n> for the full stream lifecycle.\n","operationId":"streamHeatmap","parameters":[{"name":"symbol","in":"query","required":true,"description":"Single ticker to stream (e.g. `SPY`). One symbol per connection.","schema":{"type":"string","example":"SPY"}},{"$ref":"#/components/parameters/Metric"},{"$ref":"#/components/parameters/MaxStrikes"}],"responses":{"200":{"description":"An SSE stream of heatmap events.","content":{"text/event-stream":{"schema":{"type":"string","description":"SSE frames, e.g. `event: snapshot_update` then `data: {SymbolHeatmap}`.\nThe snapshot_update `data` payload matches #/components/schemas/SymbolHeatmap.\n"}}}},"400":{"$ref":"#/components/responses/BadRequest"},"401":{"$ref":"#/components/responses/Unauthorized"},"403":{"$ref":"#/components/responses/Forbidden"},"404":{"$ref":"#/components/responses/NotFound"},"429":{"$ref":"#/components/responses/RateLimited"}}}}}

## SKY033 https://docs.skylit.ai/api-reference/flow/raw-flow-feed-for-a-ticker-flow-score-+-flowbonus-per-trade
openapi: same as SKY029 openapi
info: {"title":"Flowseeker — Skylit Public API","version":"1.0.0","summary":"Real-time and historical options-flow analytics as a public HTTP API.","description":"Flowseeker exposes Skylit's real-time options-flow scoring stack — Flow\nScore, FlowBonus, VWF/SDF/FIR aggregates, sector rotation, and market\nbreadth — as a versioned public HTTP API. Data is sourced from the full\nOPRA options feed with sub-second freshness during market hours.\n\n**Authentication.** Send your Skylit API key as a bearer token:\n\n    Authorization: Bearer fs_live_<key>\n\n(`X-API-Key: fs_live_<key>` is also accepted.) Your rate limit and monthly\nquota are determined by your account plan.\n\n**Rate limits & quotas.** Per-minute limits are enforced by the Skylit\ngateway and surfaced on every response via `X-RateLimit-Limit`,\n`X-RateLimit-Remaining`, and `X-RateLimit-Reset`. `429` includes\n`Retry-After`; quota exhaustion returns `403` with `code: QUOTA_EXCEEDED`.\n\n**Credits & billing.** Every `/v1/*` data request debits a fixed number of\n**credits** from your account's shared Skylit balance (the same balance used\nacross all Skylit public APIs). Each chargeable response carries\n`X-Credits-Remaining: <balance>`. The credit is charged before the request\nis served, so a `5xx` still bills. Cost is priced by server-side work and\ndata volume returned:\n\n| Tier | Credits | Routes |\n|------|--------:|--------|\n| Light | 1 | single-key reads, ratios, scores, discovery/search lists, expirations, rvol, per-contract bull/bear, the flow feed |\n| Medium | 3 | charts, full chains, by-strike matrix, momentum/baseline/strikes, tide, aggregate, sweeps, market, sector, market-breadth, chain bull/bear, unusual-volume/oi screeners, dark-pool top-prints |\n| Heavy | 5 | trade feeds (`/trades`, dark-pool trades), history (`/history`, `historical-compare`), bulk endpoints |\n\n`/v1/openapi.json` is free. When you run out of credits the API returns\n`402` `insufficient_credits`; a suspended account returns `403`\n`account_suspended`; a transient billing-store error returns `503`\n`credit_check_failed` (safe to retry). These billing codes are lowercase\n(`insufficient_credits`, `account_suspended`, `credit_check_failed`) — the\nplatform-wide convention for credit errors.\n\n**Response envelope.** All success responses share one shape:\n\n    { \"data\": <payload>, \"meta\": { \"timestamp\": \"...\", \"requestId\": \"...\" } }\n\nAll errors share one shape:\n\n    { \"error\": { \"code\": \"NOT_FOUND\", \"message\": \"...\" } }\n\nField names are camelCase throughout. Codes are stable, machine-readable\n`SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE` strings — the message text may evolve.\n\n**Freshness.** Endpoints with a `timeframe` parameter (e.g. `/v1/flow/{ticker}`)\nreturn data through the last completed bucket. Intra-bucket fills land on the\nnext request. The cumulative `/v1/flow/market-breadth` and aggregate scoring\nendpoints update at most once per second.\n"}

tags: [{"name":"Flow","description":"Per-ticker flow feed, aggregate scoring, baselines, and momentum."},{"name":"Sweeps","description":"Aggregated multi-exchange sweeps and sweep-only feeds."},{"name":"Sector","description":"Sector- and industry-level flow rollups."},{"name":"Market","description":"Market-wide overview, breadth, advance/decline, sector rotation, and net-premium tide."},{"name":"Analytics","description":"Standalone analytics endpoints — Vol/OI accumulation, moneyness segmentation,\nand timeframe-aggregated sentiment scores.\n"},{"name":"Ratios","description":"Bid/ask/mid distribution analyses at chain and contract granularity, plus\ncall/put-aware bull/bear pressure breakdowns.\n"},{"name":"Scoring","description":"Per-trade scoring, sentiment, and intent classification."},{"name":"Underlying","description":"Ticker-level discovery and analytics — top tickers by flow,\nbulk stats, intraday chart bars, raw enriched trades, strike /\nexpiration distributions, option chain, and historical rollups.\n"},{"name":"Contract","description":"Per-contract discovery and analytics — top contracts by flow,\nunusual volume / OI scans, contract stats, intraday chart bars,\nraw enriched trades, and historical rollups.\n"},{"name":"Dark Pool","description":"Off-exchange (TRF) prints — paginated dark-pool trades and the\nlargest individual prints per ticker. No side / BBO / greeks.\n"},{"name":"Meta","description":"API metadata (this OpenAPI document, etc.)."}]
paths: {"/v1/flow/{ticker}":{"get":{"tags":["Flow"],"summary":"Raw flow feed for a ticker (Flow Score + FlowBonus per trade)","description":"Returns the most recent options trades for `{ticker}` within the\nrequested timeframe, each scored on Skylit's directional Flow Score\n(-100 → +100) and conviction-weighted FlowBonus. The response also\nincludes timeframe-level VWF / SDF / FIR aggregates.\n","operationId":"getFlow","parameters":[{"$ref":"#/components/parameters/Ticker"},{"$ref":"#/components/parameters/Timeframe"},{"name":"limit","in":"query","required":false,"description":"Max trades returned. Server caps this at 500.","schema":{"type":"integer","default":100,"minimum":1,"maximum":500}},{"name":"min_premium","in":"query","required":false,"description":"Minimum total premium per trade (USD).","schema":{"type":"number","format":"double","example":50000}},{"name":"option_type","in":"query","required":false,"description":"Filter to calls or puts. `all` returns both.","schema":{"type":"string","enum":["call","put","all"],"default":"all"}},{"name":"trade_type","in":"query","required":false,"description":"Filter by trade type. Comma-separated for multiple.","schema":{"type":"string","enum":["sweep","multi_leg","all"],"default":"all"}},{"name":"moneyness","in":"query","required":false,"description":"Moneyness category filter. Comma-separated for multiple\n(e.g. `otm,deep_otm`). Unknown tokens are ignored.\n","schema":{"type":"string","enum":["deep_itm","itm","atm","otm","deep_otm","all"],"default":"all"}},{"name":"start_time","in":"query","required":false,"description":"Optional lower bound for the trade window. Accepts RFC 3339\n(`2026-05-27T13:30:00Z`) or Unix seconds. (inclusive).","schema":{"type":"number","format":"double"}},{"name":"max_strike","in":"query","required":false,"description":"Maximum strike price weights.\nWeights must be non-negative and sum to within 0.95–1.05, else 400.\n","schema":{"type":"string"}},{"name":"min_flow_score","in":"query","required":false,"description":"Filter to trades with `flowScore` ≥ this value (-100..100).","schema":{"type":"integer","minimum":-100,"maximum":100}},{"name":"min_flow_bonus","in":"query","required":false,"description":"Filter to trades with `flowBonus` ≥ this value.","schema":{"type":"integer","minimum":0}},{"name":"min_rvol","in":"query","required":false,"description":"Filter to trades with relative volume ≥ this multiple.","schema":{"type":"number","format":"double","minimum":0,"example":2}},{"name":"include_clusters","in":"query","required":false,"description":"If `true`, attach `cluster*` fields when a trade is part of a\nmulti-leg cluster (sweep, condor, etc.).\n","schema":{"type":"boolean","default":true}},{"name":"date","in":"query","required":false,"description":"Trading date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to current trading date.","schema":{"type":"string","format":"date","example":"2026-05-27"}}],"responses":{"200":{"description":"Flow feed for `{ticker}`.","headers":{"X-RateLimit-Limit":{"schema":{"type":"integer"}},"X-RateLimit-Remaining":{"schema":{"type":"integer"}},"X-RateLimit-Reset":{"schema":{"type":"integer"}},"X-Credits-Remaining":{"description":"Credit balance remaining after this request was charged.","schema":{"type":"integer"}}},"content":{"application/json":{"schema":{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/FlowSuccess"}}}},"400":{"$ref":"#/components/responses/BadRequest"},"401":{"$ref":"#/components/responses/Unauthorized"},"402":{"$ref":"#/components/responses/InsufficientCredits"},"403":{"$ref":"#/components/responses/Forbidden"},"404":{"$ref":"#/components/responses/NotFound"},"429":{"$ref":"#/components/responses/RateLimited"},"503":{"$ref":"#/components/responses/Unavailable"}}}}}

paths: {"/v1/market/tide":{"get":{"tags":["Market"],"summary":"Bucketed market-wide net call premium / net put premium time series","description":"Returns the market-wide intraday \"tide\" — bucketed Net Call\nPremium and Net Put Premium series with both per-bucket and\ncumulative values, plus an SPY price overlay for context. Two\ndirectional flavors are emitted per bar: the standard `ncp`/`npp`\n(call-buying minus call-selling, etc.) and a `manualNcp`/\n`manualNpp` variant with the script-trade exclusion logic\nrelaxed for callers that need raw flow.\n","operationId":"getMarketTide","parameters":[{"name":"interval","in":"query","required":false,"description":"Trailing window length. Defaults to a single trading day\n(`1D`); multi-day intervals roll up history at the chosen\nbucket size.\n","schema":{"type":"string","enum":["1D","2D","3D","5D","7D","14D","30D","45D","60D","90D","120D","180D","360D"],"default":"1D"}},{"name":"bucket","in":"query","required":false,"description":"Bucket size for the time series.","schema":{"type":"string","enum":["1min","5min","15min","30min","1d","1w"],"default":"5min"}},{"name":"date","in":"query","required":false,"description":"Trading date anchor (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Defaults to today.","schema":{"type":"string","format":"date"}},{"name":"exclude_multi_leg","in":"query","required":false,"description":"Exclude multi-leg / spread trades from the directional totals.","schema":{"type":"boolean","default":false}},{"name":"exclude_deep_itm","in":"query","required":false,"description":"Exclude deep in-the-money trades (`moneyness_percent < -20`) from\nthe directional totals.\n","schema":{"type":"boolean","default":false}}],"responses":{"200":{"description":"Market tide bars.","content":{"application/json":{"schema":{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/MarketTideSuccess"}}}},"400":{"$ref":"#/components/responses/BadRequest"},"401":{"$ref":"#/components/responses/Unauthorized"},"402":{"$ref":"#/components/responses/InsufficientCredits"},"403":{"$ref":"#/components/responses/Forbidden"},"429":{"$ref":"#/components/responses/RateLimited"},"503":{"$ref":"#/components/responses/Unavailable"}}}}}

paths: {"/v1/aggregate/{ticker}":{"get":{"tags":["Analytics"],"summary":"Aggregate sentiment scoring across timeframes (VWF / SDF / FIR / Composite)","description":"Returns a Composite directional score plus its VWF / SDF / FIR\ncomponents for one or more trailing timeframes (intraday or\nmulti-day). Optional moneyness breakdown, optional time-decay\nweighting, and a comparative trend block contrasting short- vs\nlong-horizon sentiment. Reference: PRD Section 8.\n","operationId":"getAggregate","parameters":[{"$ref":"#/components/parameters/Ticker"},{"name":"timeframes","in":"query","required":false,"description":"Comma-separated timeframes, or `all`. Supported atoms:\n`1h, 4h, 1d, 7d, 30d, 90d`. `all` expands to all six. Unknown\natoms are treated as a single trading day.\n","schema":{"type":"string","default":"1d","example":"1d,7d,30d"}},{"name":"include_breakdown","in":"query","required":false,"description":"Attach the per-timeframe VWF/SDF/FIR component split.","schema":{"type":"boolean","default":true}},{"name":"include_moneyness","in":"query","required":false,"description":"Attach a `byMoneyness` array (deep_itm → deep_otm).","schema":{"type":"boolean","default":false}},{"name":"moneyness_filter","in":"query","required":false,"schema":{"type":"string","enum":["deep_itm","itm","atm","otm","deep_otm","all"],"default":"all"}},{"name":"expiration_filter","in":"query","required":false,"description":"Restrict to one expiration bucket.","schema":{"type":"string","enum":["0dte","weekly","monthly","leaps","all"],"default":"all"}},{"name":"time_decay","in":"query","required":false,"description":"Apply exponential time decay to VWF / SDF / FIR components.","schema":{"type":"boolean","default":false}},{"name":"time_decay_half_life","in":"query","required":false,"description":"Half-life in minutes for the decay (only applied when `timeDecay=true`).","schema":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"default":30}},{"name":"date","in":"query","required":false,"schema":{"type":"string","format":"date"}}],"responses":{"200":{"description":"Aggregate sentiment by timeframe.","content":{"application/json":{"schema":{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/AggregateSuccess"}}}},"400":{"$ref":"#/components/responses/BadRequest"},"401":{"$ref":"#/components/responses/Unauthorized"},"402":{"$ref":"#/components/responses/InsufficientCredits"},"403":{"$ref":"#/components/responses/Forbidden"},"404":{"$ref":"#/components/responses/NotFound"},"429":{"$ref":"#/components/responses/RateLimited"},"503":{"$ref":"#/components/responses/Unavailable"}}}}}

Only the requested timeframes appear; missing\nentries indicate the underlying query failed for that horizon.\n"},"trend":{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/TrendAnalysis"},"byMoneyness":{"type":"array","description":"Present when `includeMoneyness=true`.","items":{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/MoneynessAggregate"}}}}

paths: {"/v1/score/{trade_id}":{"get":{"tags":["Scoring"],"summary":"Detailed scoring for a single trade","description":"Returns sentiment, urgency, and confidence scores for an individual\ntrade plus a spread-level breakdown and full trade context (ticker,\nstrike, expiration, sweep/block flags, moneyness). paths: {"/v1/dark-pool/trades":{"get":{"tags":["Dark Pool"],"summary":"Paginated off-exchange (TRF) prints","description":"Server-side filtered dark-pool prints from the off-exchange tape\n(FINRA TRF, publisher FINN/FINC). Defaults to **today (ET)** with a\n**$1,000,000** minimum notional (the blocks-by-default rule); pass\n`min_notional=0` for the full firehose. The trade-date span is capped\nat **31 days** per request — page with `limit`/`offset` or narrow the\nrange for more. Prints carry **no side, BBO, or greeks**. Pagination\nstate (`limit`, `offset`, `count`, `hasMore`) is returned in `meta`.\n","operationId":"getDarkPoolTrades","parameters":[{"name":"tickers","in":"query","required":false,"description":"Comma-separated tickers to include (e.g. `AAPL,NVDA`). Omit for all names.","schema":{"type":"string","example":"AAPL,NVDA"}},{"name":"date","in":"query","required":false,"description":"Single trade date (`YYYY-MM-DD`, ET). Defaults to today (ET).","schema":{"type":"string","format":"date"}},{"name":"date_start","in":"query","required":false,"description":"Inclusive start of a trade-date range (`YYYY-MM-DD`, ET). Max span 31 days.","schema":{"type":"string","format":"date"}},{"name":"date_end","in":"query","required":false,"description":"Inclusive end of a trade-date range (`YYYY-MM-DD`, ET). Max span 31 days.","schema":{"type":"string","format":"date"}},{"name":"time_start","in":"query","required":false,"description":"Inclusive lower bound of the time-of-day window (`HH:MM`, ET).","schema":{"type":"string","example":"09:30"}},{"name":"time_end","in":"query","required":false,"description":"Inclusive upper bound of the time-of-day window (`HH:MM`, ET).","schema":{"type":"string","example":"16:00"}},{"name":"min_notional","in":"query","required":false,"description":"Minimum notional (USD). Defaults to 1,000,000. Pass 0 for the firehose.","schema":{"type":"number","format":"double","default":1000000}},{"name":"max_notional","in":"query","required":false,"schema":{"type":"number","format":"double"}},{"name":"min_size","in":"query","required":false,"schema":{"type":"integer","minimum":0}},{"name":"max_size","in":"query","required":false,"schema":{"type":"integer","minimum":0}},{"name":"min_price","in":"query","required":false,"schema":{"type":"number","format":"double"}},{"name":"max_price","in":"query","required":false,"schema":{"type":"number","format":"double"}},{"name":"sectors","in":"query","required":false,"description":"Comma-separated GICS sectors to include.","schema":{"type":"string"}},{"name":"industries","in":"query","required":false,"description":"Comma-separated GICS industries to include.","schema":{"type":"string"}},{"name":"venue","in":"query","required":false,"description":"Reporting venue filter. Omit for both.","schema":{"type":"string","enum":["FINN","FINC"]}},{"name":"limit","in":"query","required":false,"description":"Page size (server caps at 5000).","schema":{"type":"integer","default":500,"minimum":1,"maximum":5000}},{"name":"offset","in":"query","required":false,"description":"Row offset for pagination.","schema":{"type":"integer","default":0,"minimum":0,"maximum":50000}},{"name":"order","in":"query","required":false,"description":"Sort by trade time.","schema":{"type":"string","enum":["asc","desc"],"default":"desc"}}],"responses":{"200":{"description":"Paginated dark-pool prints for the requested filters.","content":{"application/json":{"schema":{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/DarkPoolTradesSuccess"}}}},"400":{"$ref":"#/components/responses/BadRequest"},"401":{"$ref":"#/components/responses/Unauthorized"},"402":{"$ref":"#/components/responses/InsufficientCredits"},"403":{"$ref":"#/components/responses/Forbidden"},"429":{"$ref":"#/components/responses/RateLimited"},"503":{"$ref":"#/components/responses/Unavailable"}}}}}

## SKY092 https://docs.skylit.ai/api-reference/history/ohlcv-price-bars-for-a-symbol-and-resolution
openapi: same as SKY029 openapi
info: {"title":"Atlas Public API","version":"1.0.0","summary":"OHLCV price history as a TradingView-UDF datafeed.","description":"Atlas exposes Skylit's real-time and historical **OHLCV** (open / high / low\n/ close / volume) price bars as a versioned public HTTP API that implements\nthe TradingView **UDF** (Universal Data Feed) datafeed contract. Point a\nTradingView Charting Library datafeed at `https://atlas-api.skylit.ai/v1`, or\ncall the endpoints directly.\n\n**Authentication.** Send your Skylit API key as a bearer token:\n\n    Authorization: Bearer <key>\n\n(`X-API-Key: <key>` is also accepted.) One Skylit key spans every product —\nthe same key and credit balance work for Heatseeker and Flowseeker.\n\n**Credit metering.** Each chargeable request debits a fixed cost from your\nbalance:\n\n| Endpoint       | Cost |\n|----------------|-----:|\n| `/v1/history`  | 1    |\n| `/v1/search`   | 1    |\n| `/v1/symbols`  | 1    |\n| `/v1/config`   | 0    |\n| `/v1/time`     | 0    |\n\nNew customers are seeded with 5,000 credits. Every chargeable response\ncarries `X-Credits-Remaining: <balance>`. Out of credits → `402`\n`insufficient_credits`; an admin-suspended account → `403`\n`account_suspended`. `/v1/config` and `/v1/time` are free metadata calls.\n\nNote that a charting client fetches `/v1/history` in **pages** (it walks the\n`to` cursor backward to fill the requested range), so a deep history pull\nnaturally costs one credit per page — the cost scales with the data you\nactually retrieve.\n\n**Request-window limit.** One `/v1/history` call may span at most a fixed\nnumber of **trading days**, set by the bar tier the resolution reads from —\nnot by the resolution itself. `240` and `60` share the 1-hour tier and\ntherefore share its allowance.\n\n| Tier   | Resolutions                | Max trading days / request |\n|--------|----------------------------|---------------------------:|\n| 1-min  | `1` `2` `3` `5` `15` `30`  |                         90 |\n| 1-hour | `60` `240` `480`           |                        720 |\n| 1-day  | `D` `W`                    |                      2,600 |\n\nA window **wider than the cap is rejected with `400`**, carrying the two\nnumbers a client needs to react (`requested_days`, `max_days`). It is never\nsilently shortened — a short `{ \"s\": \"ok\" }` always means the data ends\nthere, never that your range was clipped. Page through anything wider in\nwindows of `max_days` or fewer.\n\nA rejected `400` still debits 1 credit, because metering happens before the\nrequest is inspected. The caps are fixed and published above, so check your\nrange before sending it rather than discovering the limit by retrying — a\nclient that retries a `400` unchanged burns credits without ever\nsucceeding.\n\n**Rate limits.** A safety ceiling of 600 requests / minute is enforced by\nthe Skylit gateway and surfaced via `X-RateLimit-Limit`,\n`X-RateLimit-Remaining`, and `X-RateLimit-Reset`. `429` includes\n`Retry-After`. This is runaway protection, not a quota — credit metering\ndoes the per-customer accounting.\n\n**The datafeed flow.** A UDF client calls `/v1/config` once for the feed's\ncapabilities, `/v1/symbols` to resolve a ticker (price scale, session,\nsupported resolutions), then `/v1/history` for the bars; `/v1/search` powers\nthe symbol picker and `/v1/time` the server clock. History follows the UDF\nconvention: a `200` with `{ \"s\": \"ok\", ... }` on success and `{ \"s\":\n\"no_data\" }` when the window has no bars (not a `404`); an over-wide range\nis a `400` with `{ \"s\": \"error\", \"errmsg\": ... }` plus `requested_days` and\n`max_days`. Auth and credit errors, which aren't part of UDF, use the\nenvelope `{ \"error\": { \"code\": \"...\", \"message\": \"...\" } }`.\n"}
servers: [{"url":"https://atlas-api.skylit.ai","description":"Production"}]
security: same as SKY029 security
tags: [{"name":"History","description":"OHLCV price bars."},{"name":"Symbols","description":"Symbol search and resolution."},{"name":"Meta","description":"Datafeed configuration and server time (free)."}]
paths: {"/v1/history":{"get":{"tags":["History"],"summary":"OHLCV price bars for a symbol and resolution","description":"TradingView UDF history bars for one `symbol` at one `resolution`,\ncovering `[from, to)` (Unix seconds; `to` is exclusive). Returns column arrays (`t`, `o`,\n`h`, `l`, `c`, `v`) of equal length, oldest-first. When the window\nholds no bars the response is a `200` with `{ \"s\": \"no_data\" }` (plus\n`nextTime` pointing at the nearest earlier bar when one exists), per the\nUDF contract. Equity bars also carry sided-volume columns (`bv`/`sv`/`uv`\n= buy / sell / unclassified) where available.\n\n## Request-window limit\n\nOne call may span at most a fixed number of **trading days**, set by the\nbar tier the resolution reads from — not by the resolution itself. `240`\nand `60` share the 1-hour tier and therefore share its allowance.\n\n| Tier   | Resolutions                | Max trading days / request |\n|--------|----------------------------|---------------------------:|\n| 1-min  | `1` `2` `3` `5` `15` `30`  |                         90 |\n| 1-hour | `60` `240` `480`           |                        720 |\n| 1-day  | `D` `W`                    |                      2,600 |\n\nA window **wider than the cap is rejected with `400`**, carrying the two\nnumbers a client needs to react (`requested_days`, `max_days`). It is\nnever silently shortened — a short `{ \"s\": \"ok\" }` always means the data\nends there, never that your range was clipped. Page through anything\nwider in windows of `max_days` or fewer.\n\nA rejected `400` **still debits 1 credit**, because metering happens\nbefore the request is inspected. The caps are fixed and published here,\nso check your range before sending it rather than discovering the limit\nby retrying — a client that retries a `400` unchanged burns credits\nwithout ever succeeding. `/v1/config` is free if you would rather read\nthe feed's capabilities first.\n\nCache-Control tracks data freshness: today `max-age=2`, the prior\nsession `max-age=60`, older complete days `immutable`. A `400` is\n`no-store`.\n","operationId":"getHistory","parameters":[{"$ref":"#/components/parameters/Symbol"},{"name":"resolution","in":"query","required":true,"description":"Bar size. Intraday minutes or `D`/`W`.","schema":{"type":"string","enum":["1","2","3","5","15","30","60","240","480","D","W"],"example":"D"}},{"name":"from","in":"query","required":true,"description":"Window start, Unix seconds (UTC).","schema":{"type":"integer","format":"int64","example":1748131200}},{"name":"to","in":"query","required":true,"description":"Window end, Unix seconds (UTC).","schema":{"type":"integer","format":"int64","example":1748736000}},{"name":"countback","in":"query","required":false,"description":"When set, return exactly this many bars ending at `to` (takes\nprecedence over `from`, per the UDF spec).\n","schema":{"type":"integer","minimum":1}},{"name":"extended","in":"query","required":false,"description":"Include extended-hours (pre / post-market) bars. Default is regular\ntrading hours only (09:30–16:00 ET).\n","schema":{"type":"boolean","default":false}}],"responses":{"200":{"description":"Bars, or a `no_data` marker — both `200` per UDF.","headers":{"X-Credits-Remaining":{"$ref":"#/components/headers/CreditsRemaining"},"Cache-Control":{"schema":{"type":"string","example":"public, max-age=2"}},"X-RateLimit-Limit":{"schema":{"type":"integer"}},"X-RateLimit-Remaining":{"schema":{"type":"integer"}},"X-RateLimit-Reset":{"schema":{"type":"integer"}}},"content":{"application/json":{"schema":{"oneOf":[{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/HistoryOk"},{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/HistoryNoData"}]},"examples":{"ok":{"summary":"SPY daily (truncated)","value":{"s":"ok","t":[1748304000,1748390400,1748476800],"o":[742.1,744.02,733.9],"h":[750.18,745.61,739.94],"l":[741.55,732.88,731.2],"c":[744.38,733.68,733.05],"v":[61230400,74910200,58120900]}},"noData":{"summary":"Empty window","value":{"s":"no_data","nextTime":1746057600}}}}}},"400":{"description":"The requested range is wider than the resolution's tier allows.\nDebits 1 credit like any other metered request.\n","headers":{"X-Credits-Remaining":{"$ref":"#/components/headers/CreditsRemaining"},"Cache-Control":{"schema":{"type":"string","example":"no-store"}}},"content":{"application/json":{"schema":{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/HistoryError"},"examples":{"rangeTooWide":{"summary":"171 trading days asked of the 90-day 1-minute tier","value":{"s":"error","errmsg":"requested range spans 171 trading days; resolution \"1\" allows at most 90 per request. Narrow the range, or page through it in windows of 90 trading days or fewer.","requested_days":171,"max_days":90}}}}}},"401":{"$ref":"#/components/responses/Unauthorized"},"402":{"$ref":"#/components/responses/InsufficientCredits"},"403":{"$ref":"#/components/responses/AccountSuspended"},"429":{"$ref":"#/components/responses/RateLimited"},"503":{"$ref":"#/components/responses/Unavailable"}}}}}
component parameters/Symbol: {"name":"symbol","in":"query","required":true,"description":"Ticker (e.g. `SPY`).","schema":{"type":"string","example":"SPY"}}
component headers/CreditsRemaining: {"description":"Credit balance remaining after this request was debited.","schema":{"type":"integer","example":4999}}
component schemas/HistoryOk: {"type":"object","required":["s","t","o","h","l","c","v"],"properties":{"s":{"type":"string","enum":["ok"],"description":"Status flag."},"t":{"type":"array","description":"Bar open times, Unix seconds (UTC), oldest-first.","items":{"type":"integer","format":"int64"}},"o":{"type":"array","description":"Opens.","items":{"type":"number"}},"h":{"type":"array","description":"Highs.","items":{"type":"number"}},"l":{"type":"array","description":"Lows.","items":{"type":"number"}},"c":{"type":"array","description":"Closes.","items":{"type":"number"}},"v":{"type":"array","description":"Volumes.","items":{"type":"number"}},"bv":{"type":"array","description":"Buy (aggressor) volume per bar, equities where available.","items":{"type":"number"}},"sv":{"type":"array","description":"Sell (aggressor) volume per bar.","items":{"type":"number"}},"uv":{"type":"array","description":"Unclassified volume per bar.","items":{"type":"number"}}}}
component schemas/HistoryNoData: {"type":"object","required":["s"],"properties":{"s":{"type":"string","enum":["no_data"]},"nextTime":{"type":"integer","format":"int64","description":"Unix seconds of the nearest earlier bar, when one exists."}}}
component schemas/HistoryError: {"type":"object","description":"UDF-shaped error body for a rejected `/v1/history` request. `errmsg` is\nthe human-readable text a TradingView datafeed surfaces; `requested_days`\nand `max_days` are additive fields for programmatic callers, which are\nthe ones that have to react — compute your page size from `max_days`\nrather than hardcoding a cap that later drifts.\n","required":["s","errmsg"],"properties":{"s":{"type":"string","enum":["error"]},"errmsg":{"type":"string"},"requested_days":{"type":"integer","description":"Trading days the requested window spans."},"max_days":{"type":"integer","description":"Trading days one request may span at this resolution's tier."}}}
component schemas/Error: {"type":"object","required":["error"],"properties":{"error":{"type":"object","required":["code","message"],"properties":{"code":{"type":"string","description":"Stable machine-readable code.","example":"insufficient_credits"},"message":{"type":"string"}}}}}
component responses/Unauthorized: same as SKY029 responses/Unauthorized
component responses/InsufficientCredits: {"description":"Credit balance is below the request cost.","headers":{"X-Credits-Remaining":{"$ref":"#/components/headers/CreditsRemaining"}},"content":{"application/json":{"schema":{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/Error"},"examples":{"outOfCredits":{"value":{"error":{"code":"insufficient_credits","message":"Out of credits."}}}}}}}
component responses/AccountSuspended: {"description":"Account is not API-eligible (suspended).","content":{"application/json":{"schema":{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/Error"},"examples":{"suspended":{"value":{"error":{"code":"account_suspended","message":"Account suspended."}}}}}}}
component responses/RateLimited: same as SKY029 responses/RateLimited
component responses/Unavailable: {"description":"The credit ledger or datafeed is temporarily unavailable.","content":{"application/json":{"schema":{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/Error"}}}}

paths: {"/v1/config":{"get":{"tags":["Meta"],"summary":"Datafeed configuration","description":"The static UDF `DatafeedConfiguration` — supported resolutions,\nexchanges, symbol types, and feature flags. Free.\n\nAlso carries **`max_fetch_trading_days`**: the `/v1/history`\nrequest-window cap, keyed by every advertised resolution. Read it once\nat startup and size your history pages from it, rather than hardcoding a\nwindow that later drifts — or discovering the limit by being rejected,\nwhich costs a credit each time. This call is free precisely so the limit\nis knowable in advance.\n\nThe values are served from the same table the server enforces, so they\ncannot disagree with it. A charting client can ignore the field: it is\nnot part of the UDF spec, and TradingView skips config keys it does not\nrecognise.\n\n⚠ Cached for an hour (`max-age=3600`), so treat a `400` naming a\n`max_days` SMALLER than your cached value as authoritative and re-read\nthis endpoint.\n","operationId":"getConfig","responses":{"200":{"description":"Datafeed configuration.","content":{"application/json":{"schema":{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/DatafeedConfig"},"examples":{"config":{"value":{"supports_search":true,"supports_group_request":false,"supports_marks":false,"supports_timescale_marks":false,"supports_time":true,"supported_resolutions":["1","2","3","5","15","30","60","240","480","D","W"],"max_fetch_trading_days":{"1":90,"2":90,"3":90,"5":90,"15":90,"30":90,"60":720,"240":720,"480":720,"D":2600,"W":2600},"intraday_multipliers":["1","60"],"exchanges":[{"value":"NASDAQ","name":"NASDAQ","desc":"NASDAQ"},{"value":"NYSE","name":"NYSE","desc":"NYSE"},{"value":"ARCA","name":"NYSE ARCA","desc":"NYSE ARCA"}],"symbols_types":[{"name":"stock","value":"stock"},{"name":"fund","value":"fund"},{"name":"dr","value":"dr"},{"name":"index","value":"index"},{"name":"futures","value":"futures"}]}}}}}},"401":{"$ref":"#/components/responses/Unauthorized"}}}}}

Resolutions sharing a bar tier share a value — `60`,\n`240` and `480` all read hourly bars and all cap at 720.\n","additionalProperties":{"type":"integer"},"example":{"1":90,"60":720,"240":720,"D":2600}},"intraday_multipliers":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}},"exchanges":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"value":{"type":"string"},"name":{"type":"string"},"desc":{"type":"string"}}}},"symbols_types":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string"},"value":{"type":"string"}}}}}}
